title: Friendly Adventures
description: A vanilla-plus modpack focused on exploration, cooperation, and relaxed multiplayer adventures.
body:
## Friendly Adventures

**Friendly Adventures** is a vanilla-plus modpack focused on exploration, cooperation, and relaxed progression.

Created with multiplayer in mind, the modpack enhances the core Minecraft experience without overcomplicating it. It adds new structures, improved mechanics, and quality-of-life features that make exploration and survival more immersive while keeping the game familiar and intuitive.

Perfect for long-term worlds and playing with friends, **Friendly Adventures** encourages shared journeys, building together, and creating stories naturally — without rushing the endgame.

### Features
- Vanilla-plus gameplay
- Exploration-focused world
- Multiplayer-friendly balance
- Quality-of-life improvements
- Cozy and atmospheric experience

### Recommended
- Playing with friends
- Long-term survival worlds
- Relaxed progression
